قلوا (form I)
# قَلُّوا (qallū) /qal.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of قَلَّ (qalla)
# قِلُّوا (qillū) /qil.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of قَلَّ (qalla)
# قُلُّوا (qullū) /qul.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of قَلَّ (qalla)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
